asset_metadata.name: app-fdroid-arm64-v8a-release-signed.apk
asset_metadata.finding: Fresh read-only GitHub API metadata matched the exact tag, asset ID/name/URL/size/digest and upstream F-Droid artifact SHA/size; actual APK bytes and signer still require a completed download.

local_environment: Current nanhai_plus_env.py --json reports /opt/19.SourceCode, project evidence/staging roots and /usr/bin/curl matching run.py's intended variables. Script itself only trusts inherited NANHAI_* values; it does not reload local_env.md or bind its config SHA before creating staging.
positive_controls: Current G284 RESULT and staging generation do not exist; G282 failed .part remains in a separate generation and is not resumed.
--execute is explicit; API asset identity is rechecked before one curl -q, --retry 0, HTTPS-only APK GET with timeout and isolated .part.
Fixed source/tool SHA values match current local files; downloaded bytes must match registry/GitHub SHA and size before ZIP CRC, package/version/ABI and v2 signer checks.
No container, namespace, graph, device or canonical ledger action is coded. Curl command records transfer metrics rather than effective signed redirect URL.
blocking_findings: staging.mkdir and multiple registry/tool assert checks occur before receipt initialization; failures leave a created staging directory without RESULT.json. Python -O can disable the assert identity gates.
JSON parsing, subprocess launch errors, ZIP errors, disk/readback errors and several other exceptions bypass save(); no top-level finally persists a failure receipt.
save() overwrites RESULT.json directly without exclusive creation, fsync or atomic finalization, so the one-shot receipt is neither immutable nor crash-safe.
Environment paths are not compared with a fresh authoritative local_env parse before mutation; tool subprocesses inherit the full environment, which should be reduced to the required keys.
minimum_repair: Validate current local_env and exact path roots first; replace asserts with explicit checks. Create a unique exclusive IN_PROGRESS/REMOTE_STATE_UNKNOWN-equivalent local receipt before staging/network work, catch all exceptions into a terminal failure receipt, and finalize by fsynced no-replace rename/link. Keep the APK GET disabled until peer review of the repaired exact script SHA.
scope: Static/local metadata review plus small official GitHub API request only; APK GET 0, device 0, container 0, graph 0, canonical edits 0.
